title: Bucking Kid Punch; Bud Brunies and the Fostham band
summary: He tells how bands advertised against each other and stayed friendly, then lists bands he joined including Fostham's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So we went over there, the brothers looked at us, you know. He was playing music. Punch and, uh, Brother Petit, they were his buddies, you know. And you know, when we meet on the valley, that's what they call it sometimes, by advertising, we buck against one another. And so they say, Kid Punch over here. And the man got scared, you know. He said, he kept me looking at us, and he said, uh, he said, now it's the same band here, Andrew. I said, they playing out there, but we got a better band this time. He said, yeah, he said, but Kid Punch coming, he said. He said, well, we buddy, you know, what we going to do. So, well, we went on, you know. And when we meet, we play one-two, then we drive off. And we go, and we were buddy, we always, you know, we was buddy, you see. We didn't buck against one another. And then when we got, uh, they closed parts of them down. They couldn't make that. And we had so many people that we couldn't get in that part. Then they came over, and they played a couple of turns, you know. Let's see. Bud Bruchey, you know what I mean? He's an old bass player. Uh, uh. Who did he play with? Yeah, I used to play with him too. Who did he play with? Who he had with him? Bud Bruchey. He had me, his Fostham, Fostham brother, and, uh.
